Spanish

Kokoro ships Spanish voice packs, but kokoro-js only ever phonemises as English and then applies English-only fixups, which turn Spanish into noise. We phonemise with the full espeak-ng build instead and feed the model token ids directly. The model has no published grade for these.

Doraes_dora_castil — Español de España · FemeninaDistinción — "gracias" con zeta. Misma voz, otro acento.

Que la inteligencia artificial sea una puerta abierta, no un laboratorio cerrado. No hace falta un título en informática para usarla. Talleres gratuitos en tu barrio, en tu idioma.

Spanish from Spain

The three above are Kokoro packs. Pointing the phonemiser at es rather than es-419 gets Castilian pronunciation out of them — the zeta comes back — but that is an accent worn by a voice whose origin the model author never states. There is no published grade and no training-hours figure for Kokoro's Spanish, the only language in its voice list with neither.

These are the other thing: Piper voices recorded in Spain, run locally through onnxruntime at build time. Lower fidelity than Kokoro — 22.05kHz against 24 — and plainly a Spaniard reading.

What the English voices are saying

Make AI feel like an open door, not a locked lab. You do not need a computer science degree to use this. Free workshops in your neighbourhood, taught in your language.

The rule this voice lives under

It may read our own published words, labelled as synthetic, with the written text on the same page. It may never speak as a named person, read a learner's quote, or appear anywhere a listener could think they are hearing a specific human being.

A synthetic face invents a person who does not exist. A synthetic voice reading our own prose is a reading aid, much like a screen reader. The moment it speaks as somebody, it becomes the same lie. Full policy: docs/07-photography.md.

Changing it

One flag. The narration is regenerated locally and committed — nothing is called at runtime, and no reader's text is ever sent anywhere.

cd tools
npm run narrate -- --voice af_heart --force
